# Onity

> Onity (`com.onity.framework`) is one Unity package for dependency injection, reactive state, typed messaging, factories and pooling, and `OnityTask` async. It gives them one idiom, one disposal model and an engine-free, unit-testable core, and it replaces Zenject or VContainer, R3 or UniRx, MessagePipe and UniTask in a Unity 2022.3 project. Read the AI usage guide first, then only the feature guide the task needs. The package source and its tests are the authority when a document disagrees with the code.

All paths are relative to this file, the package root. `Documentation~/` is generated from the repository's `docs/` folder and is ignored by Unity, so it is plain Markdown on disk.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI coding agents, and how to install the `onity-use` skill into a project.
- [AI usage guide](Documentation~/AI/Onity-AI-Usage-Guide.md): the index and rules; source-verified API surface, recipes, a per-module API index and an error-to-fix table.
- [Getting started](Documentation~/Getting-Started.md): install Onity and build a first scene with dependency injection, reactive state and typed events.
- [onity-use skill](Documentation~/AI/skills/onity-use/SKILL.md): agent skill for code that consumes Onity; copied into a project by `Onity/AI/Install Assistant Guidance...`.

## Guides

- [Guides index](Documentation~/guide/index.md): task-oriented walkthroughs of each Onity pillar.
- [Dependency injection](Documentation~/guide/dependency-injection.md): `OnityContainer`, binding and injection, resolve behavior.
- [Reactive](Documentation~/guide/reactive.md): `IOnityObservable<T>`, `Subject<T>`, `ReactiveProperty<T>`, operators and subscription lifetime.
- [Events and messaging](Documentation~/guide/events-messaging.md): typed pub/sub with `MessageChannel<T>`, the broker, `OnityEventHub` and `OnityEvent`.
- [Async with OnityTask](Documentation~/guide/onitytask.md): frame waits and PlayerLoop timings, timed waits and timers, composition, triggers and UI events, async streams and channels, scope lifetimes, Unity operations, and the reactive and messaging bridges.
- [Lifecycle and scopes](Documentation~/guide/lifecycle-and-scopes.md): lifetimes, child containers, startup and per-frame lifecycle interfaces, context ownership.
- [Factories and pooling](Documentation~/guide/factories-and-pooling.md): `BindFactory`, `BindPooledFactory` and prefab pools.
- [Performance and IL2CPP](Documentation~/guide/performance-and-il2cpp.md): DI activation paths on Mono and IL2CPP, benchmark evidence and allocation caveats.
- [Refactoring from existing architecture](Documentation~/guide/refactoring-from-existing-architecture.md): moving singleton managers and scene-order assumptions to injected services and thin MonoBehaviours.
- [OnityTask and UniTask comparison](Documentation~/guide/onitytask-comparison.md): measured workloads, API coverage and current limits (long, measurement-heavy).

## Migration

- [Migration index](Documentation~/Migration/index.md): mappings for moving an existing project onto Onity.
- [From Zenject](Documentation~/Migration/From-Zenject.md): Zenject and Extenject binding, injection and lifecycle mappings.
- [From VContainer](Documentation~/Migration/From-VContainer.md): VContainer registration, lifetimes and entry points.
- [From R3 and UniRx](Documentation~/Migration/From-R3.md): reactive primitives, operators and subscription lifetime.
- [From UniTask](Documentation~/Migration/From-UniTask.md): UniTask 2.5.11 names mapped to `OnityTask`, behavior differences, assembly references and the upgrade notes from Onity 0.5.
